entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought it online.
Okay, I can help with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see here you ordered a VeloBand Pulse. What seems to be the issue with it?
The issue is I don't want it anymore! It doesn't really do what I thought it would. I want my money back.
I understand. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on the 1st of the month, and today is the 16th. Unfortunately, our return window is 10 days from the delivery date.
What?! 10 days? That's ridiculous! I didn't even have time to try it out properly. This is a faulty product, I demand a full refund.

I understand your frustration. However, the 10-day return window is clearly stated in our return policy, which is available on our website and was included in your order confirmation email. I am showing that the delivery date was the first, and it is now past the return window.
This is outrageous! So you're telling me I'm stuck with this useless thing? I want to speak to your supervisor! Make a policy exception for me! I'm a loyal customer!

I understand your frustration, and I want to help. While a full refund isn't possible due to being outside the return window, I can offer you store credit for the current value of the VeloBand Pulse. This store credit can be used on any product on our website and does not expire.
Store credit? Ugh, fine. I guess that's better than nothing. But I'm still not happy about this short return window. I needed time to test it properly.
I understand. I'll go ahead and process the store credit for you now. You should receive an email with the details within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Will the store credit cover the full amount I originally paid for the VeloBand Pulse, even including shipping?
Yes, the store credit will cover the full amount you paid, including any original shipping costs. You'll be able to use it on any new purchase you'd like.
Okay, alright. Well, thanks, I guess. I appreciate you doing that for me. I thought I was going to be stuck with it.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your understanding. Is there anything else I can help you with today regarding the VeloBand Pulse return or the store credit?
No, I think that's all. Thanks for your help.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
